responsibility: Declaration of the `brig_function` class that encapsulates all state and helper services for translating one BRIG function or kernel. It exposes APIs for label creation, variable/register management, kernel argument layout, work-item loop and metadata generation, builtin expansion, vector packing, statement emission, call analysis, and basic-block state tracking, and it defines the persistent per-function data members that the BRIG handlers mutate during lowering.
same_name_distinction: Defines the brig_function class interface and its persistent translation-state members for one BRIG function/kernel; the companion brig-function.cc contains the operational logic for those APIs and state transitions.
